name: Heinz Brendel
features: fair skin, dark hair combed back, youthful rounded face, bright eager eyes, compact build, ready grin, white overalls with rolled sleeves
bio: The son of a racing driver, Brendel was racing sports cars at seventeen and earned an invitation to Mercedes-Benz's famous young-driver trials of 1936-37 at the Nürburgring and Monza. Not fast enough for a Grand Prix seat, he was kept on as test and reserve driver, practising at the 1937 German Grand Prix. His race debut finally came at the Nürburgring in 1939 — and ended with Neubauer's pit board ordering him in, to hand his healthy car over to team leader Hermann Lang.
